 Al-Hilal board ‘want parity applied’ after Al-Nassr vs Al-Wasl postponement 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Koooora reports that Al-Hilal’s hierarchy are unhappy after rivals Al-Nassr had their AFC Champions League Elite tie with Al-Wasl postponed. The third-round match had been set for Monday evening.
 The Asian Football Confederation called off the game, citing logistical considerations and current developments across the region.
 OneFootball Videos
 An Al-Hilal source said the club view the stance as contradictory. Al-Hilal had asked to postpone their own meeting with Al-Sadd due to the same circumstances, but the request was rejected.
 They were told to travel by land, and that breaking the decision would count as withdrawal from the tournament.
 The refusal has angered the board, who want the same principle of parity applied to every side as they pursue all available titles.
 Al-Hilal beat Al-Sadd 2-0 in Qatar and now lead the standings on six points, having won both of their opening two rounds.
 Source: Goal.com
